nom: RoC Cleansing Pads, Hypoallergenic Exfoliating Makeup Remover Pads

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, combination, or breakout-prone skin (including at 56 years old) describe the pads as an effective deeper cleanse, especially around the nose, forehead and chin, without complaints of over-drying.
segments.dry: A few reviewers note the product can dry out skin if overused (recommending a thick moisturizer and only using it once or twice weekly), while most others report it cleans without stripping or dehydrating.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, acne-prone, or 'very angry' skin and eyes report no irritation and comfortable use, including on skin with hair-dye residue removed painlessly.
segments.mature: Reviewers aged roughly 40 to 70 report smoother, brighter, firmer-looking skin, reduced fine lines and dark spots, and frequent compliments, with one noting slight over-tightening after prolonged use.
segments.combination: One long-term reviewer with combination/oily/breakout-prone skin at 56 uses the pads for deeper exfoliating cleanses several times a week.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, smoother texture, and brighter, firmer-looking skin over days to weeks, including one describing a forehead frown line disappearing after a week; one reviewer notes over-tightening after about a month of regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the pads cleanse without stripping or drying skin, describing it as soft and not tight afterward; one reviewer warns the product can dry out skin if used too frequently without a rich moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A sensitive-skin reviewer with 'angry' skin and eyes reports no irritation from the scent or formula.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report visible fading of dark spots or brown discoloration within one to two weeks, with one noting spots returned after stopping use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports no new breakouts after about a month; another with large pores and acne at 25 reports diminishing pores and glowing skin after four days; a third recalls the product kept breakouts controlled in her early 30s.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin describe the pads as effective for deeper cleansing of oily zones (nose, forehead, chin) without reporting excess oiliness afterward.

aspects.libelle: Good value, large pads can be cut

extraits.titre: ⭐️ Longtime Fan Deeply Disappointed in the New Formula
extraits.texte: I've been using RoC Resurfacing Discs since they first hit the market back in the early 2000s, I was around 20 or 21 at the time. I discovered them while looking for something to exfoliate my face and remove makeup, and I was instantly hooked. I used to buy them in bulk, months at a time, because they were that good and I didn't want to run out. Over the years, I got my husband to use them, and even my late teenage kids from time to time. Friends would compliment my skin and ask what I used, and I'd always recommend these discs. They left my skin so smooth and clean. I loved the texture of the pads and the refreshing formula. They truly worked. But recently, I ran out of my old stock (the ones in the gold container) and ordered more. When I received the new version in the white container, I could tell immediately that something had changed. The pads felt different, thinner, softer, not exfoliating the same way. The formula smelled and felt off. It doesn't scrub or clean the skin like before, and instead, it leaves a film on my face. I absolutely hate it. I thought I got fake RoC sent to me, but nope, it's legit. I'm so disappointed. After using and recommending this product for over 20 years, I now have to look for something new. Please, please bring back the original formula and pads! The old version was perfect! Why change something that worked so well for so long? Judging by other reviews, I know I'm not the only one who feels this way

I really like these cleansing pads! I use them for my morning cleanse to prep my 40 years old skin for the day. My skin looks brighter and feels smoother after use! My makeup goes on smoother thanks to the gentle exfoliation. They do have kind of a strong scent. I enjoy the scent but i can see it being too strong for some. The price is unbeatable!

I absolutely love this product! I've dealt with oily acne prone skin all my life. I'm 44 years old and still battle with acne here and there. I use these at night as my face wash. They are amazing!!! I woke up and my skin feels pretty clean. Not sure if it's this product or it's luck but I haven't broken out since I started using these. I've been using them for close to a month. I'll use one in the morning if I'm in a hurry or showered the night before. I'll definitely stay stocked up in these.
I have sensitive and acne prone skin, and these pads do not irritate. They are perfectly effective at removing makeup, and even removed the semi-permanent hair dye from my skin.

I'm now out of denial and have been searching for the right products for my 48 year old skin (lines, dark spots, dullness). I promise you after just ONE use my skin was glowing and it felt tight but not dry. I'm now on day 5 and the dark spots have significantly diminished, my pores are smaller, and my skin is SO smooth! Note, I am using these pads as a part of my new daily regimen with only RoC products. I finally found what works for me:)

I've been using this products for almost a year and it works great. I've been using anti-aging since I was 16 and I am 34 now. I've noticed an over tightness of my face after about a month of using this. I only use this product about once or twice a week, and make sure to use a good thick moisturizer because it can dry out your skin. But overall, the pads offer a good exfoliation.

Cleans my skin and prepares it for moisturizer. I had two ugly dark raised spots on my forehead. After about two weeks the brown was gone. Tried to go without the pads and the brown came back. Will not stop using again. I have sensitive skin but these pads did not bother me.
